---
title: "Geom Functions"
subtitle: "Every geometric object in ggplot2 with working code examples"
description: "Complete reference for all ggplot2 geom functions — scatter, line, bar, histogram, boxplot, violin, density, area, tile, text, and more."
---

Geoms are the **geometric objects** used to represent data. Every geom function starts with `geom_`. You can stack multiple geoms in one plot by chaining them with `+`.

---

## Scatter — `geom_point()`

```r
library(ggplot2)

# Basic scatter
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point()

# Colour, size, alpha
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8)

# Add regression line
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "tomato")

# Bubble chart — size mapped to data
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, size = hp, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 12))
```

---

## Lines — `geom_line()` / `geom_path()`

```r
# Time-series line chart
ggplot(economics, aes(x = date, y = unemploy)) +
  geom_line()

# Styled line
ggplot(economics, aes(x = date, y = unemploy)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#2d6be4", linewidth = 1)

# Multiple lines by group
ggplot(economics_long, aes(x = date, y = value01, colour = variable)) +
  geom_line()

# Step line (useful for step-wise data)
ggplot(economics, aes(x = date, y = unemploy)) +
  geom_step()

# geom_path — connects in data order (not sorted by x)
ggplot(economics, aes(x = unemploy/pop, y = psavert)) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "Unemployment rate", y = "Personal savings rate")
```

---

## Bars — `geom_bar()` / `geom_col()`

```r
# Count bars (default stat="count")
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_bar()

# Identity bars (pre-summarised)
df <- data.frame(group = LETTERS[1:4], values = c(5,2,7,2))

ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = values)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")

# geom_col — shorthand for stat="identity"
ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = values, fill = group)) +
  geom_col()

# Horizontal with coord_flip
ggplot(df, aes(x = values, y = reorder(group, values))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2d6be4")

# With value labels on top
ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = values)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = values), vjust = -0.4, fontface = "bold")
```

---

## Histogram — `geom_histogram()`

```r
# Basic histogram
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10)

# Custom bin width & fill
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 3, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white")

# Density overlay
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg, y = after_stat(density))) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#c3e7ff", colour = "white", bins = 12) +
  geom_density(colour = "#2d6be4", linewidth = 1)

# Multiple groups
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg, fill = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, binwidth = 2, position = "identity")
```

---

## Density — `geom_density()`

```r
# Basic density
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5)

# Multiple groups
cyls <- as.factor(mtcars$cyl)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg, fill = cyls)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# 2D density heat map
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_density_2d_filled(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(colour = "white", size = 1.5)
```

---

## Boxplot — `geom_boxplot()`

```r
# Basic boxplot
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg)) +
  geom_boxplot()

# Coloured fill + notches
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg, fill = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_boxplot(notch = TRUE, outlier.colour = "tomato", outlier.size = 2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# With jittered points overlaid
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "grey90", outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = factor(cyl)), width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.7)
```

---

## Violin — `geom_violin()`

```r
# Basic violin
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6)

# Violin + boxplot combo
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg, fill = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, fill = "white") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Cylinders", y = "MPG")

# Half violin — gghalves package
# install.packages("gghalves")
# library(gghalves)
# ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg)) +
#   geom_half_violin() + geom_half_point()
```

## Area — `geom_area()` / `geom_ribbon()`

```r
# Area chart
ggplot(economics, aes(x = date, y = unemploy)) +
  geom_area(fill = rgb(0, 0.5, 1, alpha = 0.5), colour = "#2d6be4")

# Ribbon — shaded confidence band
ggplot(economics, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = unemploy - 500, ymax = unemploy + 500),
              fill = "#2d6be4", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = unemploy), colour = "#2d6be4")

# Stacked area chart
library(tidyr)
economics_long |>
  dplyr::filter(variable %in% c("pce","pop")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value01, fill = variable)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.7, position = "stack")
```

## Heatmap — `geom_tile()` / `geom_raster()`

```r
# Correlation matrix heatmap
library(tidyr)

cor_df <- as.data.frame(cor(mtcars))
cor_df$var1 <- rownames(cor_df)
cor_long <- pivot_longer(cor_df, -var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "corr")

ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = var1, y = var2, fill = corr)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2d6be4", mid = "white", high = "#e84855", midpoint = 0
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "mtcars Correlation Matrix", fill = "r")

# Calendar heatmap style
ggplot(diamonds, aes(x = cut, y = color, fill = carat)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c()
```

## Smooth trend — `geom_smooth()`

```r
# Default LOESS smooth
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth()

# Linear regression
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "tomato")

# By group
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

# method options: "lm", "glm", "gam", "loess", "rlm"
```

---

## Jitter — `geom_jitter()`

```r
# Avoid overplotting in categorical data
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, colour = "steelblue", size = 2, alpha = 0.7)

# geom_jitter is shorthand for geom_point(position = position_jitter())
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15), size = 3, alpha = 0.7)
```

## Error bars — `geom_errorbar()` / `geom_crossbar()`

```r
library(dplyr)

# Compute mean and SE per group
summary_df <- mtcars |>
  group_by(cyl) |>
  summarise(mean_mpg = mean(mpg),
            se_mpg   = sd(mpg) / sqrt(n()))

# Error bar plot
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mean_mpg)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_mpg - se_mpg,
                    ymax = mean_mpg + se_mpg),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Cylinders", y = "Mean MPG ± SE")

# Point + errorbar
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mean_mpg)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, colour = "#e84855") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_mpg - se_mpg,
                    ymax = mean_mpg + se_mpg),
                width = 0.2)
```

---

## Rug marks — `geom_rug()`

```r
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.6)

# Only on x-axis
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_rug(sides = "b")   # "b"=bottom, "l"=left, "t"=top, "r"=right
```

---

## Complete Geom Reference

| Geom | Chart type | Required `aes()` |
|------|-----------|-----------------|
| `geom_point()` | Scatter | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_line()` | Line (sorted x) | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_path()` | Line (data order) | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_step()` | Step line | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_bar()` | Bar (counts) | `x` |
| `geom_col()` | Bar (identity) | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_histogram()` | Histogram | `x` |
| `geom_density()` | Kernel density | `x` |
| `geom_density_2d()` | 2D density contour | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_boxplot()` | Boxplot | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_violin()` | Violin | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_dotplot()` | Dot plot | `x` |
| `geom_jitter()` | Jittered scatter | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_area()` | Area chart | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_ribbon()` | Shaded band | `x`, `ymin`, `ymax` |
| `geom_tile()` | Heatmap tiles | `x`, `y`, `fill` |
| `geom_raster()` | Raster image | `x`, `y`, `fill` |
| `geom_smooth()` | Smoothed trend | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_hline()` | Horizontal ref line | `yintercept` |
| `geom_vline()` | Vertical ref line | `xintercept` |
| `geom_abline()` | Diagonal line | `slope`, `intercept` |
| `geom_segment()` | Line segment | `x`,`y`,`xend`,`yend` |
| `geom_curve()` | Curved segment | `x`,`y`,`xend`,`yend` |
| `geom_text()` | Text labels | `x`, `y`, `label` |
| `geom_label()` | Text with box | `x`, `y`, `label` |
| `geom_errorbar()` | Error bars | `x`, `ymin`, `ymax` |
| `geom_crossbar()` | Crossbar | `x`, `y`, `ymin`, `ymax` |
| `geom_polygon()` | Filled polygon | `x`, `y` |
| `geom_map()` | Map polygons | `map_id` |
| `geom_rug()` | Marginal rug marks | `x` or `y` |
| `geom_blank()` | Empty — axis range only | `x`, `y` |

::: {.callout-note}
## Additional geom packages
- **`ggrepel`** — `geom_text_repel()`, `geom_label_repel()` for non-overlapping labels  
- **`ggtext`** — `geom_richtext()` for Markdown/HTML in annotations  
- **`ggbeeswarm`** — `geom_beeswarm()` for beeswarm scatter  
- **`ggridges`** — `geom_density_ridges()` for ridge plots  
- **`ggsignif`** — `geom_signif()` for significance brackets  
:::
